北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天湿度高，体感较热，记得带伞，注意防潮哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and humid, feels warm. Bring an umbrella and stay dry!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波晴天，体感 30℃，湿度较高。多补水防晒，保持清爽。
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo is sunny, feels like 30℃, high humidity. Hydrate, use sunscreen, stay cool.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海晴热，体感 31℃，紫外线强，出门别忘了防晒和多补水。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is sunny and hot, feels like 31℃. Strong UV, hydrate and use sunscreen!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州小雨，体感 28℃，湿度大。出门带伞，路面湿滑，注意安全。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou has light rain, feels like 28℃, high humidity. Bring umbrella, watch for wet roads!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，体感 30℃ 稍闷。湿度高，注意防暑，保持清爽。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy, feels stuffy at 30℃. High humidity, stay cool and refreshed.

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州多云，体感 30℃，空气有点潮。外出多喝水，小心中暑哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy, feels like 30℃ and humid. Drink water, beware of heatstroke.

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京多云，风力 4级，湿度大。外出注意防风，小心衣物着凉。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy, wind level 4, high humidity. Watch for wind, avoid catching a chill.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，湿度 100%，感觉闷闷的。注意防潮，保持室内通风。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy, 100% humidity, feels stuffy. Stay dry, ventilate indoors.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云闷热，体感 32℃！湿度超高，请注意防暑降温哦。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy and sweltering, feels like 32℃! Extreme humidity, stay cool!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感 27℃，湿度适中。外出愉快，注意补水哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny, feels like 27℃, moderate humidity. Enjoy outdoors, stay hydrated!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云炎热，体感 32℃！紫外线强，防晒和补水要做好。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and hot, feels like 32℃! Strong UV, use sunscreen and hydrate.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨小雨，体感 20℃，略有凉意。记得带伞，小心着凉。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin has light rain, feels like 20℃, a bit chilly. Bring umbrella, avoid catching a cold.

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴天，体感 24℃，湿度高。紫外线虽不强，但仍需注意防晒。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny, feels like 24℃, high humidity. UV not strong, but still mind sunscreen.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 16℃，湿度大。早晚温差大，注意添衣保暖。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy, feels like 16℃, high humidity. Large temp difference, dress warmly.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，体感 28℃，湿度高。能见度低，驾车出行请注意安全。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy, feels like 28℃, high humidity. Low visibility, drive safe!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，风力 4级。海边风大，注意防风保暖，小心着凉。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy, wind level 4. Windy by sea, stay warm, avoid catching a cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，风力 4级。海边风大，注意防风，小心吹感冒。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, wind level 4. Windy by sea, watch for wind, avoid catching a cold.

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦有雾，体感 28℃，湿度大。能见度低，外出注意交通安全。
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is foggy, feels like 28℃, high humidity. Low visibility, watch traffic safety!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪晴天，体感 30℃，湿度 100%，出门防晒补水，注意排汗哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is sunny, feels like 30℃ with 100% humidity. Hydrate and protect from sun!
